mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ADDRESS_ID AS addressId, USER_NO AS userNo, ZIP_CODE AS zipCode, ADDRESS AS address, ADDRESS_DETAIL AS addressDetail, IS_DEFAULT AS isDefault FROM USER_ADDRESS WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY DECODE(IS_DEFAULT, 'Y', 0, 1), ADDRESS_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT ADDRESS_ID AS addressId, USER_NO AS userNo, ZIP_CODE AS zipCode, ADDRESS AS address, ADDRESS_DETAIL AS addressDetail, IS_DEFAULT AS isDefault FROM USER_ADDRESS WHERE ADDRESS_ID = #{addressId} AND USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ADDRESS (USER_NO, ZIP_CODE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, IS_DEFAULT) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_ADDRESS SET IS_DEFAULT = 'N' WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND IS_DEFAULT = 'Y'
